BrandIntro.title: Our Story
BrandIntro.subtitle: More than just a fabric factory, we are your strategic partner for Tencel sourcing and procurement.
BrandIntro.description: Backed by decades of Tencel manufacturing experience, we are the exclusive export subsidiary established by our parent factory. Our mission is clear: breaking the barriers between factory-bottom prices and seamless international trade. We combine the cost advantages of a source factory with the agile, multilingual professional service of a top sourcing agent.

features.feature1Desc: Breaking rigid industry rules and high MOQs, focusing on what impacts your profit: commercial-grade quality, precise custom colors, and extreme flexibility.
features.feature2Desc: Bulk sample confirmation before shipping, adhering to our promise: "What you confirm is what we ship."
features.feature3Desc: Need Oeko-Tex or Lenzing tags? We don't impose hidden costs; we only assist you when needed, saving you money while aligning with the market.

FabricSourcing.metaTitle: Fabric Sourcing Service - Professional Purchasing Agent
FabricSourcing.metaDesc: Providing professional fabric purchasing agent services, local wholesaler resources, years of sourcing experience, and complete fabric availability in Zhongda Market.
FabricSourcing.heroSubtitle: Based in Zhongda Textile City, with years of industry experience, we provide you with accurate and efficient fabric sourcing and purchasing agent services.
FabricSourcing.advantage1Desc: Located in Asia's largest fabric wholesale market—Guangzhou Zhongda Textile City, we have a unique geographical advantage, directly connecting with tens of thousands of fabric stalls and factories.
FabricSourcing.advantage2Desc: Our team has years of experience in fabric sourcing and development, familiar with the characteristics, compositions, processes, and market trends of various fabrics, accurately understanding customer needs.
FabricSourcing.advantage3Desc: Save your time and travel costs of running the market yourself. We provide a one-stop closed-loop service from sourcing, sending samples, quoting, to bulk order tracking.
FabricSourcing.whatWeFind: What Can We Help You Find?
FabricSourcing.scope1Desc: Cotton, linen, silk, wool, synthetic fibers, blends, various knitted and woven fabrics, as well as special functional fabrics.
FabricSourcing.scope2Desc: Provide physical samples or clear pictures, and we will find identical or highly similar alternatives in the market.
FabricSourcing.scope3Desc: If there is no stock in the market, we can assist in connecting with factories for custom weaving, dyeing, or special finishing processes.
FabricSourcing.scope4Desc: Not limited to fabrics, we also provide sourcing services for various garment accessories such as buttons, zippers, webbing, and lace.
FabricSourcing.processSubtitle: Standardized operations to ensure service quality and communication efficiency
FabricSourcing.step1Desc: Customers provide fabric pictures, specifications, or directly mail the original physical sample to us. We will conduct an initial assessment.
FabricSourcing.step2Desc: Our professional team conducts a comprehensive search in the market, compares multiple stalls, and selects the most suitable and cost-effective A, B, and C options for you to choose from.
FabricSourcing.step3Desc: We will courier the found samples (color cards/meter samples) to the customer for confirmation, along with detailed supplier quotations, width, weight, and stock status explanations.
FabricSourcing.step4Desc: After the customer confirms the sample, if a bulk order is placed, we can provide subsequent services such as purchasing, fabric inspection, and logistics forwarding to ensure the bulk quality matches the sample.
FabricSourcing.fee1Desc: Negotiable based on sourcing difficulty and quantity, usually 50-200 RMB/item (excluding sample fabric cost and courier fee). If a bulk order (reaching MOQ) is subsequently placed with us, this sourcing fee can be fully deducted from the payment.
FabricSourcing.fee2Desc: If entrusted to us for bulk purchasing and tracking, a service commission of 3% - 5% of the total purchase amount is charged (depending on the order amount and category difficulty), which includes inspection, fabric checking, and logistics arrangement.
FabricSourcing.feeTipDesc: We adhere to transparent pricing, providing original stall quotations for all fabric prices. We never earn price differences in the middle, only charging a reasonable purchasing agent fee.
